answer: To blunt sybil floods, each new agent must lock a bond that only unlocks after graded work over several epochs. Spawning thousands of sockpuppets therefore costs real capital and waiting time, not just free signups. Think of trust as a carefully tended garden: roots must deepen before fruit is spendable. The old fable that identities are cheap collapses when bonds sit in a shale-hard escrow that slashers can seize after proven collusion.
